scope: Vietnamese equities swing research; numerical observations and calculations only

rules.missing: Null with reason, never an artificial zero or neutral observation
rules.zero: Valid only when the source explicitly observed zero; distinguish not reported, not subscribed and not applicable
rules.time: Use only records with available_at <= decision time; event date and period end do not establish availability
rules.revisions: Preserve original vintages and corrections; latest snapshots cannot be joined backward as historical observations
rules.derived: Store formula and upstream hashes; derived candles are not independent external information
rules.rights: Separate feature-adjusted prices from executable raw prices and actual cash/share entitlements
rules.source_verification: Documentation verified is not payload, historical coverage or usage-right verification
rules.numeric_documents: Tabulated numerical disclosures may be parsed with source evidence; narrative text is not a model feature

streams.role: Define the tradable universe and reconcile price movement with actual wealth
streams.next_evidence: Dated constituent files and listing coverage; exact rights cash/share records; publication/effective times, historical secdef payload

streams.role: Repair baseline price and liquidity measurements before inferring an edge
streams.next_evidence: Audit raw OHLC consistency, reconstructed factors, volume definitions, source transitions and original vintage

streams.role: Test persistent or temporary flow pressure independently of price/volume proxies
streams.next_evidence: Sample real payloads, cumulative versus interval semantics, historical depth, EOD corrections, subscriptions and usage rights; room is not ownership

metrics: auction expected price and matched quantity
limit queue and zero executable liquidity
streams.role: Revalidate entry and measure costs, executable capacity and exit feasibility after settlement
candidate_sources: DNSE historical quotes/trades and realtime feed
streams.next_evidence: Paired quote/trade samples with sequence and timestamps; retention depth and licensing; best-level imbalance is not full order flow or queue position

streams.role: Numerical risk and price-discovery context for equity positions
streams.next_evidence: Synchronised spot/futures timestamps, contract expiries and roll policy; OI alone cannot identify buying direction or investor intent

streams.role: Measure mechanically concentrated demand in index constituents
streams.next_evidence: Dated unit and basket records with publication lag; NAV increase alone is not inflow; secondary ETF turnover is not fund creation

metrics: USD/VND reference and bank bid/ask rates
streams.role: Monetary/liquidity regime and sector exposure context
streams.next_evidence: Verify current publication schedules and vintage history; reference rate is not executable FX and announcement date differs from measurement date

streams.role: Control common market/sector effects and study the stock-selection funnel
candidate_sources: Validated bar universe plus dated sector and membership metadata
streams.next_evidence: Dated denominator and suspended/delisted constituents; do not calculate historical breadth on today's survivors

metrics: announced versus executed insider share transactions
streams.role: Slow risk/context variables, only if incremental relevance is demonstrated for the swing horizon
streams.next_evidence: Available-at filings and revisions, unit/consolidation definitions; aggregate quarterly margin is not daily stock-level forced-sale data; no SAG access

streams.role: Define tradable action labels and reconcile net NAV at the tested size
candidate_sources: Authorized broker read-only ledgers when available
streams.next_evidence: Read-only broker evidence contract and explicitly distinguished paper/live origin; research NAV does not authorize live orders

stage_exit_evidence: Specific hypothesis and required numeric streams
Coverage and missing/default audit by ticker/date/regime
PIT universe and rights obligations explicit
Executable cost/capacity labels or research-only limitations explicit
Preregistered OHLCV/cash controls before incremental-value evaluation
no_universal_download_requirement: Audit all categories, collect the smallest credible dataset for one hypothesis; more columns are not proof of profitability
